articles.title: Pentagon inspector general says Iran war has caused weapons shortages - CBS News
articles.description: The first-of-its-kind report acknowledges the military's munition shortfall and details some of the losses of American assets so far as part of Operation Epic Fury.
articles.content:
The Defense Department's inspector general revealed Monday that the United States is facing a shortfall in ammunition as a result of its costly war in Iran.
